title: Sokaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Mon Mayuree
desc: Priyo, a poor orphan, secures a job through his mentor Sunil Da. Meanwhile, he falls for his boss's daughter, but a child calling him father sparks trouble.

title: Mayer Adhikar
desc: Joy falls for Asha after she helps him recover from a mysterious accident.

title: Porinaam
desc: Raghu falls in love with Nisha, but her father opposes their union. To gain his approval, Raghu decides to enter her house disguised as a servant.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Pooja
desc: A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.
